name: My door is sticking and won’t latch—what should I do first?
description: Start with alignment: hinges, strike plate, and door sweep. Many sticking doors need adjustment, not replacement.

mainEntity.name: My door is sticking and won’t latch—what should I do first?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the door sticks, scrapes the floor, or will not latch, the first step is usually a hinge and strike-plate adjustment rather than a full replacement. A technician can check alignment, tighten or reset hardware, and plane the edge only if needed.
